line: A traveller walks toward a distant mountain; every shot is a woodblock print, a great wave at the climax, the mountain and the whole scroll at the end.
line_cn: 旅人走向远山，每个镜头都是一幅版画；巨浪是高潮，结尾是远山与整幅画轴拉远。

camera.expresses: Reading a print on a wall
camera.serves: a place; a portrait; a still moment

camera.move: Handscroll slide, right → left through the mounting gap (shorter slides = urgency)
camera.serves: a journey; a sequence of steps; a race

camera.move: Very slow push toward a framing device (a window, a fan, a gate)
camera.serves: discovery; longing; a detail that matters

camera.move: Tilt past the border into the mount
camera.serves: a flood; a rumour; a giant

camera.move: Pull-back from one sheet to many
camera.serves: a summary; a timeline; a collection

camera.move: Crash-zoom into the texture (grain, specks, fibres)
camera.expresses: The medium itself becomes the image
camera.serves: a dream; a breakdown; a memory dissolving

camera.move: Pan across a triptych (three sheets side by side)
camera.expresses: One scene too wide for one sheet
camera.serves: a procession; a battle; a festival

camera.move: Hard cut to a blank sheet
camera.serves: aftermath; a pause before a decision

transitions: Allowed transitions: scroll slides, printing reveals, a wash back to paper, a cut to blank.
labels: Subtitle = a horizontal cartouche: a cream slip with a thick + thin ink border and a small red seal at the left; Shippori Mincho (500) in sumi, centred near the bottom. It "prints" in with the reveal mask and fades out. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s). It covers the bottom ~150 px: keep ground lines and figures above it.

View cartouche: vertical cream slip, thick + thin border, a pale tab with the series title, the view title below in a brush font (e.g. Yuji Syuku), a seal beside: the "full stop" of each view. Titles live on the print as cartouches and seals, never as floating type.
motion: Prints are still. Most of the frame does not move; each view has one or two small actions (steam, rain, a lantern, a falling leaf).
Figures and nature step at 8 fps; rain and fast water at 12 fps; the camera moves on ones (24 fps). A stepped camera judders.
Printing reveal: each block appears over ~0.3 s with a diagonal baren sweep with a noisy edge, sliding 5–6 px into registration as it lands (pure noise looks like mould).
Cartouches drop in (fade + a short slide); a seal stamps (scale ~1.35 → 1 in 0.2 s).

native_moves.name: A series of views
native_moves.does: One constant subject in different compositions; the story is told by where it sits in the frame each time.
native_moves.fits: one building through a century; a product in five homes; the same street in four seasons.

native_moves.name: The handscroll
native_moves.does: Scenes don't cut; the camera slides right to left and the next print arrives.
native_moves.fits: a supply chain; the stations of a pilgrimage; the steps of a recipe.

native_moves.name: Printing, block by block
native_moves.does: Key line first, then each colour lands slightly off and snaps into register.
native_moves.fits: a building going up; an idea taking shape; a character being "made" for the story.

native_moves.name: Paper is the white
native_moves.does: Foam, snow, mist and blank sky are unprinted paper; white can flood the frame and wash the print back to a blank sheet.
native_moves.fits: a snowfall that erases a town; forgetting; a clean start.

native_moves.name: The frame is an object
native_moves.does: Border, cartouche and seal are physical; something big enough breaks out of the border into the mount.
native_moves.fits: a festival that can't be contained; a legend; a runaway success.

native_moves.name: Alternate impressions
native_moves.does: The same key block reprinted with different colour blocks (day → night, spring → winter).
native_moves.fits: before and after; a city lit at night; two lives in one house.

native_moves.name: The triptych
native_moves.does: A scene split across three sheets that join.
native_moves.fits: three generations; a panorama of a harbour; a debate between three voices.

score.note: shamisen, shakuhachi-like flute, taiko; miyako-bushi scale, silence as ma
